runs straight south from Queen City, starts curving SE here
curve ends; straight SSE to here and beyond
angle point, turns more to the SE (both curbs break here)
angle point, Harrison turns SE towards Colerain and the canal; the Harrison/Colerain crossing is south of this sheet

SW end of the iron bridge over the Miami Canal: the bridge's west parapet turns SE here as a double-line wall along Colerain's NE side, and the approach continues SE between that wall and the canal bank, off the bottom of the sheet; no direct junction with Colerain on this sheet

ends.note: south end at the Sayers & Scovill carriage works line; continues only as the 10' alley west to Bogen

notes: Two unnamed 10' alleys: Bogen to Zwick at the Sayers & Scovill yard, and an L-shaped one from Bogen behind the Harrison Av lots that turns south to Harrison (two segments). Spring Grove widens to 122' near Harrison (east curb steps out at y 5940); the street continuing south of Harrison is McLean Av per the key map (not printed here; key map: McLEAN AV., which becomes Division further south), its centre is about 116 px east of Spring Grove's 100' centreline, so Spring Grove and McLean are recorded as two T's. 'Turner Alley' (20', south of Harrison) and 'Winchell Avenue' are named from the key map; this sheet prints only WINCHELL. 'Iron Bridge' is the bridge road over the Miami Canal towards W. McMicken Av (sheet 236), labelled only IRON BRIDGE. It does not open straight onto Colerain: the west parapet continues SE from the bridge's SW corner as a double-line wall that forms Colerain's NE edge (Colerain is only about 45-53' between it and the SW curb), and the approach runs SE between that wall and the canal, so its merge with Colerain is south of this sheet. Recorded as a bend only, no intersection. Bogen widens from 50' to about 56' south of y 2285 (west curb steps out). An unlabelled white strip between the Sayers & Scovill and J.H. Day buildings (Bogen at y 5460 to the Day yard near Colerain) looks like a private yard passage and is not recorded.
